strengths: Clean one-page executive hierarchy, readable table, restrained footer, and a single routing note.
Thirty paragraphs and one table remain visually legible without clipping.
defects: Too compressed and polished for a full internal analysis or working memorandum.
The handwriting treatment should not become a package-wide default.
confidence_limits: Suitable only for concise executive or approved-record archetypes.

patterns: Use restrained one-page structure for a board decision or approved handoff endpoint.
prohibited_content: All company names, transaction facts, dates, financial values, conclusions, and handwritten text.
sanitization: Recreate the hierarchy with new facts and role-appropriate routing; do not clone the source file.
proof_gate: Render the full document, verify table geometry, and confirm the chosen archetype genuinely warrants one page.
